paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with Tunable TM_020 mode
notes: New exclusion limits from cavity haloscope search using TM_020 mode with auxetic tuning. Mass range 21.38–21.79 µeV (5.17–5.27 GHz). Coupling limit: g_agamma > 12.0 × g_KSVZ_agamma ≈ 1.31 × 10^-13 GeV^-1 at 90% CL. Local DM density assumed: ρ_KSVZ = 0.45 GeV/cm³ (standard halo model). Bayesian analysis yields 10.9 × g_KSVZ_agamma. Horizontal line encoding reflects mass-independent bound over stated search range.
